Witset Nation Coryatsaqua (Moricetown) 2 Reserve, 1899_2024
https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/7HJATZ

Georeferenced map of Witset Nation Oschawwinna 3 reserve east of Bulkley River clipped from the original Plan No. 1 of the Hagwilget Indian Reserves, Cassiar District (https://doi.org/10.58066/2ksn-xy80). Land cover and features include types of trees, and a meadow, as well as a trail to Fraser Lake.
